name: Shuhang Chen
tagline: I work mainly in Unity and C#. LOCKDOWN and Last Mile are solo projects, Nancy did the art for Trail Adventure, and Sniff & Snitch is a team capstone.
bio: Most of my games start from something I lived through. LOCKDOWN is my family's lockdown in Shanghai in 2022, Trail Adventure is the hiking I did with a camera after moving to the US, and Last Mile is the delivery riders and robots I pass on the street.

I'd rather the rules carry the feeling than the text. In LOCKDOWN the pan is always a little too small for the food, and in Last Mile every order you give one rider is money the other three don't earn.
